edits.original: Access checks default to fail-closed, rather than open.
edits.reason: "Open" is the ordinary, general-knowledge antonym of "fail-closed" in access-control contexts, so the "rather than open" trailer adds nothing and should be cut.

edits.original: Those privilege limits are imposed on purpose, rather than by accident.
edits.replacement: Those privilege limits are imposed on purpose.
edits.reason: "By accident" is the ordinary, general-knowledge antonym of "on purpose," so the "rather than by accident" trailer adds nothing and should be cut.
